tools.name: schoolbustrack_ping
tools.description: Show which school this key acts for, its name, its scopes and its rate limit. Good first call. SchoolBusTrack API: GET /v1/ping.

tools.name: schoolbustrack_list_students
tools.description: List pupils with their class, campus, route assignment and active flag. Guardian and emergency contact details are never returned. Needs students:read. SchoolBusTrack API: GET /v1/students.

tools.name: schoolbustrack_get_student
tools.description: Get one pupil by id: class, campus, route assignment and status. Guardian and emergency contact details are never returned. Needs students:read. SchoolBusTrack API: GET /v1/students/{id}.

tools.name: schoolbustrack_list_routes
tools.description: List bus routes with their type, schedule, stop count, bus and driver. Needs routes:read. SchoolBusTrack API: GET /v1/routes.

tools.name: schoolbustrack_get_route
tools.description: Get one route by id, with its ordered stops. Needs routes:read. SchoolBusTrack API: GET /v1/routes/{id}.

tools.name: schoolbustrack_list_buses
tools.description: List buses with registration, seats, status, tracker state and last known location. Needs buses:read. SchoolBusTrack API: GET /v1/buses.

tools.name: schoolbustrack_list_bus_locations
tools.description: Get the latest position of every bus, with speed, heading and whether the fix is stale. Needs locations:read. SchoolBusTrack API: GET /v1/buses/locations.

tools.name: schoolbustrack_get_bus_location
tools.description: Get the latest position of one bus by id. Needs locations:read. SchoolBusTrack API: GET /v1/buses/{id}/location.

tools.name: schoolbustrack_list_trips
tools.description: List scheduled, running and completed trips. Filter by school day or time range, status, route, bus, driver or campus. Needs trips:read. SchoolBusTrack API: GET /v1/trips.

tools.name: schoolbustrack_get_trip
tools.description: Get one trip by id: status, times, distance, duration, its stops and student count. Needs trips:read. SchoolBusTrack API: GET /v1/trips/{id}.

tools.name: schoolbustrack_get_trip_manifest
tools.description: Get the boarding list of one trip: each pupil with status and last event, grouped by stop, plus unlisted pupils and counts. Needs trips:read. SchoolBusTrack API: GET /v1/trips/{id}/manifest.

tools.name: schoolbustrack_list_incidents
tools.description: List incidents and SOS alerts, newest first, with status, severity, bus, trip and driver. Needs incidents:read. SchoolBusTrack API: GET /v1/incidents.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "schoolbustrack_list_routes" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: limit, cursor, updatedSince, campusId, type, code, includeInactive
